newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates close steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates close steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Wednesday on low buying by textile mills due to high prices and are likely to remain unchanged on Thursday, dealers said.
The prices had not fallen despite unsold stocks of about 1.8 million 375-lb bales lying at ginning factories, a dealer at the Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 2,250 and 2,350 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the K-68 between 2,525 and 2,550 and the MNH-93 between 2,525 and 2,575, the dealer said.
